meaning: Well-foundedness of existing direct support eliminates the nonterminating forms, so descent from a bearer reaches a terminus (terminusOfWellFounded). If that terminus were in or said of something, the two open bridges would give it an existing direct supporter, contradicting the terminus; so it is neither, and the Categories reading gives the supplied primary-substance predicate. The bridges carry the step from support-minimality to the Categories test and are not attributed to Aristotle. Passing that negative test does not give a separately supplied substance predicate (NegativeTestControl). No necessity, uniqueness, soul or God follows.
